input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 (p0024) creates a one-year term with annual auto-renewal terminable "by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice", so the notice mechanics sit at the fallback: the Company has a 90-day convenience/non-renewal right, and HDI's mirror right operates only to stop renewal at an anniversary (i.e., end of term) and requires the full 90 days. The material failure is the exit charge. Section 4.2(a) (p0026) imposes a Termination Payment on the Company alone equal to half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, payable in eight quarterly instalments (p0029), with no reciprocal payment from HDI (p0028). Fees under Section 3.1 are 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, so at, e.g., $2,000,000 of annual Net Sales the exit charge is roughly $600,000 against about $140,000 of three months' fees — far above the fallback cap of three months of fees, and a penalty on a right the playbook expects to be exercisable without penalty. We therefore replaced only the payment formula with a three-month fee measure, leaving the 90-day notice architecture (which already meets fallback) untouched rather than upgrading to the preferred 30-day/pro-rata-refund position. Section 1.6's "without penalty" right is a for-cause remedy and does not cure this.

proposal.summary: Cap the Company's Termination Payment at three (3) months of Section 3.1 fees instead of half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We can live with the mutual ninety (90) day end-of-term notice in Section 4.1, but not with a Company-only exit charge of half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales less $800,000. Our fallback position caps any early-termination fee at three months' fees, so Section 4.2(a) now measures the Termination Payment by the three (3) months of Section 3.1 payments preceding the Termination Date.

ops.oldText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to, and shall in no event exceed, the aggregate payments due to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
